Type: sofa
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Brooker Down-Filled Mid-Century Sofa, 76"W, Quarry
Colors: Quarry
Materials: Hardwood
This mid-century sofa with removable and reversible down-filled cushions offers comfort, while the hardwood frame and tapered legs increase its daily wear-and-tear durability. Whether used as a focus piece or a foundational piece, tufted back cushions add a touch of elegance to any room. 76"W x 38"D x 35"H Solid hardwood frame, down-filled cushions, tapered wood legs Removable and reversible down-filled cushions This mid-century sofa adds elegance and comfort to any room. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Avoid moisture. Wipe with a soft, dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
